scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:browser && npm run e2e:performance && npm run e2e:native
scripts.e2e:build:browser: env -u NO_COLOR trunk build --release --dist dist-e2e --html-output index.html index.e2e.html
scripts.e2e:build:native: env -u NO_COLOR cargo tauri build --debug --no-bundle --features e2e --config src-tauri/tauri.e2e.conf.json
scripts.e2e:browser: npm run e2e:build:browser && wdio run e2e/wdio.browser.conf.mjs
scripts.e2e:native: npm run e2e:build:native && wdio run e2e/wdio.native.conf.mjs
scripts.e2e:performance: npm run e2e:build:browser && wdio run e2e/wdio.performance.conf.mjs
scripts.e2e:live: npm run e2e:build:native && wdio run e2e/wdio.live.conf.mjs
